cases.query: Here are my notes from the client call. What should the approvals screen actually show, and which of our components build it?
Client feedback says managers keep missing late projects and asks for a pie chart on the dashboard. Figure out what we should build.
I have a CSV of vendors with price, lead time, rating, and region. How should we show this so buyers can pick one?
Turn this outline for the onboarding page into UI: which patterns, which existing components, and where it fits in the app.
Write FR and NFR requirements with acceptance criteria for project renaming: editors can rename, viewers cannot.
Here's a sample API response for invoices. Should this be a table, cards, or a list, and what do we already have that builds it?
Product sent a one-line request: show team capacity somewhere. Interpret it and propose how it should appear in the app.
The client wants an AI portal and we don't know who uses it or why. Help me pin down the user, the outcome, and the smallest useful scope.
This settings page has too much competing for attention. Rank what goes first and rewrite the headings and button labels.
We already know the dashboard shows a late-projects list, four figures, and a chart. Lay out the content area on our grid with gutters and a width cap.
Build the vendor comparison table from our shadcn components and report what you reused versus created.
Give me three different options for the late-projects strip so I can flip between them in the page.
Map the invoice approval flow from submission to payment, including rejection and timeout branches.
Plan which pages the admin area needs and how its navigation is grouped.
